fusions.name: Ring-Splitter
fusions.desc: Jabs a chain spike into the target for 5 damage, leaving it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed Mail
fusions.desc: Bursts your conjured mail outward, which deals 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Riveted Layer
fusions.desc: Closes a coat of links around you that absorbs the next 20 damage for 8 seconds and raises your armour by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Conjured Hauberk
fusions.desc: Conjures a coat of chain mail: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, 8% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it, and your maximum health rises by 10.
